correctness.rationale: The coefficient pairing H=(lambda(x^(i+j))) in Z[x]/(P_k) is anti-triangular with ones on anti-diagonal and unimodular, so scalar-period equality on all j implies x^t=1 in the quotient. Mod2 P_k=(x^(k+1)+1)/(x+1), giving order exactly k+1 because no smaller power x^t (t≤k) equals 1 in degree<k and x^(k+1)=1. The integral identity x^(k+1)=1+2(x^k−1), where u=x^k−1 and ux^k are nonzero modulo 2, yields exact 2-adic squaring valuations and period 2^(r−1) lift with no exception at r=1 or k=2. Independent direct state cycles for 91 k,r pairs corroborate, not prove, all k and r.

final_claim: For the impulse-initialized order-k Fibonacci recurrence, least period modulo 2^r is exactly (k+1)2^(r−1), every k≥2,r≥1.
